subject: Updates
text: McLeod Russel India Limited filed a revised outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November, 2026, to correct a typographical error in the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The company stated the correction is clerical and does not impact financial figures or profitability. Independent auditors Lodha & Co issued an adverse review report on the financial results. The auditors cited significant uncertainties regarding the recoverability of Inter Corporate Deposits aggregating Rs. 2,86,050 lakhs, with Rs. 41,421 lakhs remaining unprovided. Other issues included non-determination of fair values for assets, lease rents, and statutory liabilities, as well as non-recognition of interest on loans. The report highlighted a going concern assumption due to current liabilities exceeding current assets and operational losses affecting net worth. Borrowings have been restructured subject to conditions precedent, and the company's ability to continue depends on fulfilling these conditions and asset monetization.

text: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited disclosed that the Cane Commissioner, Uttar Pradesh, allocated meagre sugarcane to its Simbhaoli and Brijnathpur units and nil allocation to the Chilwaria unit for the 2026-27 sugar season. Substantial cane purchase centres were diverted to other mills. The company challenged this order, but the appellate authority dismissed the appeal on 12th November 2026. The company is challenging this decision before a higher judicial forum. The rejection is expected to significantly adversely impact cane availability, crushing volume, capacity utilization, sugar production, revenue, and profitability. Financial impact cannot be reliably quantified. Crushing operations commenced at the Brijnathpur unit on 14th November 2026. Operations at the Simbhaoli and Chilwaria units have not commenced due to insufficient or non-allocation of cane. Workers at the Simbhaoli unit are on strike demanding adequate cane allocation.

LLP, issued an adverse conclusion. The auditors stated the financial results have not been prepared fairly in all material respects. Key issues include Inter Corporate Deposits aggregating to Rs. 2,86,050 lakhs given to promoter group entities, which are doubtful of recovery. A provision of Rs. 2,44,629 lakhs was made earlier, leaving a balance of Rs. 41,421 lakhs unprovided. The auditors noted that profit for the period is overstated to this extent. Other matters include non-recognition of interest on loans, non-determination of fair value of assets, and pending statutory liabilities. subject: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
text: Setubandhan Infrastructure Limited, NSE symbol SETUINFRA, has not submitted its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The National Company Law Tribunal admitted the application by State Bank of India on 28 November 2022. Sandeep D. Maheshwari serves as the Resolution Professional. The Committee of Creditors approved a resolution plan, but the National Company Law Tribunal rejected it on 24 March 2025. An appeal against this rejection was filed with the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal on 09 July 2025. The matter is pending adjudication. The Resolution Professional cannot compile the financial statements because the books of accounts and relevant data are unavailable. Consequently, the company is unable to meet the submission timeline under Regulation 33 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. The Resolution Professional continues efforts to secure the records and will submit the results at the earliest.

The company maintains a zero-term-debt status, funded by internal accruals. A new manufacturing unit in Kesurdi commenced production in March 2024 with an investment of approximately INR 67 Crores, aiming to double capacity. The contract is for managed services regarding Electronic Health and Information Systems for Pharmacy and Drug Control Departments. The entity awarding the order is an international client. The agreement involves a two-year period for onboarding hospitals, clinics, health centers, and pharmacies, and a three-year period for managed services of the E-Health Eco System and National Drug Control roll-out operations. The contract is executed between SRIT’s branch in Doha QFC, Qatar, and Ooredoo QPSC. There is no interest held by the promoter group in the awarding entity, and the transaction does not constitute a related party transaction.

subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
text: Va Tech Wabag Limited informs that the tender for a 300 MLD Mega Sea Water Desalination Plant in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, awarded to the company by the Saudi Water Authority, has been cancelled. The customer notified all tender participants via the Etimad portal that the cancellation is due to internal reasons attributable to the customer. The company had executed the contract on 23 July 2025, valued at approximately USD 272 Million. Va Tech Wabag is currently approaching the customer to understand the reasons in detail and determine the next course of action. This update relates to the earlier intimation dated 24 July 2025 regarding the award of the project.

subject: Amalgamation/Merger
text: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited announced the voting results for the Scheme of Amalgamation with Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited. The resolution was approved by the requisite majority of Unsecured Creditors on November 13, 2026. Scrutinizer Dr. Biswarup Acharya reported that forty-eight Unsecured Creditors voted in favor, representing one hundred percent of the votes cast. The total value of votes in favor was twenty-seven crore thirty-three lakh sixteen thousand seven hundred seventy-one. The resolution is deemed passed under section 230(6) of the Companies Act, 2013. The company submitted the Scrutinizer's Report to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The scheme remains subject to approval by the National Company Law Tribunal.

subject: Action(s) taken or orders passed
text: Thirumalai Chemicals Limited received a show cause notice from the Deputy Commissioner, Commercial Tax Department, Ranipet, Tamil Nadu, under Section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017. The notice relates to an alleged claim of ineligible Input Tax Credit under section 17(5) of the GST Act, 2017, for the financial year 2023-24. The company will submit its response within prescribed timelines. The expected financial implications include a tax demand of Rs. 6.80 lakhs, interest of Rs. 3.14 lakhs, and a penalty of Rs. 0.68 lakhs, totaling Rs. 10.62 lakhs. The company believes these demands are erroneous and not sustainable. It states that any financial impact is likely to be insignificant and will not materially affect its financial position.

subject: Monitoring Agency Report
text: Jaykay Enterprises Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Rights Issue undertaken in 2024. The report was issued by Acuité Ratings and Research Limited. The total issue size was INR 146.14 crore. As of the reporting date, INR 137.42 crore has been utilized, leaving an unutilized balance of INR 8.72 crore. The Monitoring Agency observed no material deviations from the objects of the issue. However, progress on several objects is delayed. Specifically, the purchase of plant and machinery for JK Defence and JK Digital is delayed. The issuer has not utilized any amount for these objects during the reporting period. Additionally, the construction of buildings for JK Defence and interior works for JK Digital are delayed. Funds of INR 1.87 crore were used for the acquisition of Patange Industries Private Limited in June 2026. Unutilized proceeds are held in current accounts and fixed deposits with SBI.

subject: Press Release
text: Pricol Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved a share purchase agreement on 13 November 2026. The agreement involves Topaz Terrace Investments, an affiliate of Warburg Pincus LLC, acquiring 4,69,34,833 equity shares from promoter group members. These shares represent 38.51% of Pricol Autotech Limited on a fully diluted basis. The sellers include Mr. Vijay Mohan, Mr. Vikram Mohan, Mrs. Vanitha Mohan, and several private limited entities. The aggregate consideration is up to INR 1,663.07 Crores. The transaction is linked to the demerger of the Driver Information and Connected Vehicle Solutions business into Pricol Autotech. Completion is subject to the demerger scheme becoming effective, listing of Pricol Autotech shares, expiry of the mandatory open offer period, and approval from the Competition Commission of India. The company will not receive any consideration.

The company reported that all assets except B-80 operated at full capacity during the half-year. Management discussed plans for workovers on wells D1 and D2 at the B-80 field, aiming to resume production by late December or early January. Three new wells are planned for B-80 following workovers. In the Cauvery Basin, the PY-1 field requires intervention to restore gas production, with potential output estimated at 15 million to 20 million standard cubic feet per day. Drilling at PY-1 is contingent on securing firm take-or-pay agreements. At the Dirok field in Assam, current production averages 0.7 million standard cubic meters daily, with potential to reach 1.2 million cubic meters once pipeline bottlenecks are resolved. Additional wells are approved pending evacuation infrastructure upgrades.

subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
text: Reliance Infrastructure Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board has placed before members for approval the renewal of authorization to issue Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds up to U.S.$ 600 Million. The statutory auditors issued a disclaimer of conclusion on the financial results. The auditors were unable to assess the recoverability of Economic Rights in Odisha Discoms and unlisted entities valued at Rs. 4,705.74 Crore. They also could not determine implications of ongoing proceedings by the Enforcement Directorate, Central Bureau of Investigations, SEBI, and SFIO. Additionally, the auditor of subsidiary Mumbai Metro One Private Limited modified its review conclusion due to material uncertainty regarding the entity's ability to continue as a going concern. Mumbai Metro One Private Limited reported a loss of Rs. 701.21 crore for the period and has negative net worth. The auditors stated that material uncertainties exist that may cast significant doubt on the Group's ability to continue as a going concern.

The agreement pauses all pending legal proceedings, including a National Company Law Tribunal petition and arbitration, for a period of 12 days to explore an amicable settlement. No consideration is payable under the agreement. The standstill period begins on 13 November 2026 and may be extended by mutual written consent. Existing court orders remain in force during this period. The agreement does not grant special rights such as director appointments or share subscription preferences. The Investor holds approximately 38% of the fully diluted paid-up share capital of JPFL Films. No settlement has been reached as of the disclosure date.

subject: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
text: Astron Paper & Board Mill Limited, under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, submitted a clarification to the National Stock Exchange regarding deficiencies in financial reporting and regulatory compliance. Resolution Professional Atul J Sheth stated that the CIRP commenced on May 11, 2026, and the RP assumed responsibility only from that date. The company cited non-availability of financial records, non-cooperation from suspended management, and technical issues with the MCA portal as reasons for delays. Specific pending items include standalone and consolidated limited review reports for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and the annual report for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The RP requested reasonable time to complete requisite filings and verify historical information. The submission was made without prejudice to the rights of stakeholders and does not admit personal liability for historical non-compliances.

subject: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
text: Arshiya Limited disclosed reasons for delaying the submission of un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process since April 23, 2024, with Resolution Professional Pankaj Mahajan exercising powers. Delays stem from logistical challenges following the registered office relocation effective April 29, 2024, and significant staff attrition where 50 out of 71 employees resigned between July 30 and August 2, 2024. The Resolution Professional is currently collecting financial data, a process hindered by the non-receipt of financials from multiple subsidiaries. The company aims to submit the results at the earliest.

subject: Press Release

The award acknowledges the company’s digital infrastructure strategy, enterprise reliability, operational visibility, and measurable business outcomes. Tata Communications is recognized for evolving beyond traditional connectivity to become a strategic digital infrastructure partner for large enterprises. The company integrates global connectivity, cloud, security, edge, customer experience, automation, and end-to-end orchestration. This approach helps organizations improve visibility, centralize management, and establish secure foundations for AI and digital workloads. The recognition highlights the company’s strategic execution, platform innovation, and customer impact. The Civil Court issued an ex-parte ad-interim order on 6 November 2026, directing GBL and ABPL to show cause by December 4, 2026, why they should not furnish security of Rs. 8,27,15,948. A conditional order of attachment was also placed on certain properties. The Company plans to appeal the order. No financial implications or claims are currently expected.

subject: General Updates
text: Innovision Limited approved a change in accounting estimate relating to toll collection rights with the National Highways Authority of India. The Board revised the recognition basis for fees payable to NHAI from a straight-line method to a proportionate basis relative to estimated monthly vehicular traffic. This change applies prospectively from July 01, 2026, in accordance with IND AS 8. The revision aims to better reflect seasonal variations in traffic. For the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, the change decreased toll fee expense by ₹23.76 Crores. This resulted in a corresponding increase in profit before tax by ₹23.76 Crores. The total contractual fees payable to NHAI remain unchanged. The Board meeting concluded at 05:00 PM on November 13, 2026.

company: The State Trading Corporation of India Limited
subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
text: The State Trading Corporation of India Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report. The Independent Auditor issued a qualified conclusion on the financial statements. The report highlights several material misstatements and non-provisions. These include an overstatement of profit by Rs. 1.67 lacs due to asset handling issues with Mumbai Port Trust. Trade receivables of Rs. 1,69,953.87 lacs are considered doubtful, leading to an understatement of provisions by Rs. 1,07,226.25 lacs. Claims recoverable of Rs. 3,202.47 lacs were not written off. The company also faces penalties of approximately Rs. 175.90 Lakhs for non-compliance with SEBI regulations. The results are subject to the auditor's final review findings.

It also allows for the re-lodgement of transfer deeds originally lodged before 1st April 2019 that were previously rejected, returned, or not attended due to deficiencies. subject: Copy of Newspaper Publication
text: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. Chennai Metro Rail Limited redesigned a critical stretch between Alandur and St Thomas Mount to avoid acquiring defence land. The revised alignment involves constructing Phase 2 of Corridor 5 beneath the existing Chennai Central to St Thomas Mount corridor. This change is expected to save six months of construction time. The additional engineering work involves a supplementary tender worth around 300 crore. Chennai Metro Rail Limited plans a 45-day suspension of train services tentatively in February or March 2027, subject to approval from the Commissioner of Railway Safety. The target for completing the entire elevated stretch towards Sholinganallur is September 2027.

text: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited issued a press release regarding the launch of H-SIF, its Specialized Investment Fund platform. The first strategy, H-SIF Hybrid Long-Short Fund, is an interval investment strategy investing in equity and debt securities with limited short exposure through derivatives. The New Fund Offer period is from November 13, 2026, to November 27, 2026. The minimum investment is Rs. 10 lakh across SIF strategies at the PAN level, while accredited investors can invest a minimum of Rs. 10,000. Subscriptions are available daily, and redemptions occur twice a week on Mondays and Wednesdays. An exit load of 0.5% applies to units redeemed or switched out within 90 days of allotment. The investment strategy is proposed to be listed on NSE and or BSE.

subject: Demerger
text: Precot Limited announced on 13th November 2026 that its Board of Directors granted in-principle approval for the proposed demerger of identified non-core assets. The plan involves transferring these assets, including an investment in Suprem Associates, into a separate resulting company via a Composite Scheme of Arrangement under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. subject: Updates
text: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited reported festive season sales of Rs. 689 Crore during Diwali for the financial year 2026–27. This represents a 14% year-on-year growth. The gold segment drove performance with 13% revenue growth. Silver category sales grew by 24% year-on-year. Diamond segment growth was 8% year-on-year. Studded jewellery contributed 17.2% of sales. The overall retail average stud ratio stood at 12.6%. Newer regions in Northern and Central India showed encouraging traction. The company remains confident about the growth outlook for the upcoming wedding season.

subject: Acquisition
text: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited intimates the incorporation of GFCL EV Critical Minerals Limited on 12th November, 2026. The new entity is a wholly-owned subsidiary of GFCL EV Products Limited, a material subsidiary of the listed company. GFCL EV Critical Minerals Limited was incorporated in India with a capital of Rs. 1 lakh. GFCL EV Products Limited holds 100% shareholding in the new subsidiary through cash consideration. The new company operates in the battery chemicals industry. Its business activities include manufacturing, trading, importing, exporting, processing, and providing solutions for the entire value chain of battery types, components, and products for electric vehicles. This includes lithium-ion batteries and related products. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required for the incorporation.

The resolution was passed via postal ballot conducted through remote e-voting. The voting period commenced on 14th October 2026 and ended on 12th November 2026. The record date for eligibility was 09th October 2026. Scrutinizer Mr Sourjya Prakash Mohapatra of R K P Associates confirmed the results. The appointment is for a period of three years effective from 08th September 2026. The company filed this result with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on 13th November 2026.

subject: Press Release
text: GAIL India Limited and Krishak Bharati Cooperative Limited signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board on November 12, 2026. The agreement explores establishing a gas-based urea plant in Andhra Pradesh. The facility is planned for Mulapeta in the Srikakulam district. It will have a capacity of 1.27 Million Metric Tons Per Annum. The project will be located along GAIL’s Srikakulam Angul Natural Gas Pipeline. The MoU was signed during the 31st CII Partnership Summit 2026 in Visakhapatnam. Officials from all three entities signed the document. The Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh was present at the ceremony. This announcement serves as a press release filed with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited.

The company is ranked among the top 50 global entities. It is the only India-headquartered firm in this ranking of over 400 companies. The assessment involved a survey of 140,000 women professionals. This marks the second consecutive year of this recognition. The company reports that women hold 50% of its board positions. It cites a 99.88% return-to-work rate for women employees taking parental leave in FY26. Consolidated revenues for the twelve months ending September 2026 totaled 14.8 billion US dollars. The filing serves for information and records.

subject: Investor Presentation
text: R K SWAMY Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income for the half-year rose 10 percent to Rs 172.4 crores from Rs 156.6 crores. Profit before tax increased 26 percent to Rs 8.5 crores. For the second quarter, consolidated income grew 13 percent to Rs 86.6 crores. Profit before tax for the quarter rose 26 percent to Rs 4.0 crores. The company reported a five-year total income compound annual growth rate of 14 percent, reaching Rs 352 crores in FY 2026 from Rs 183 crores in FY 2021. The presentation outlines strategic growth drivers including digital content production and healthcare solutions. It highlights a path to margin expansion through fixed cost absorption and technology efficiencies. The company maintains a zero debt balance sheet.

subject: Outcome of Board Meeting

The company expanded its presence to 22 airports with 535 outlets. The balance sheet remains debt-free with a cash balance of Rs.10,309 million as of September 30, 2026. Passenger traffic declined by 4.8% in the quarter. The results are subject to the limited review report by M/s B S R & Co. LLP.

subject: Investor Presentation
text: Pondy Oxides and Chemicals Limited filed an investor presentation for Q2 FY 2026-27 with the NSE and BSE on 12th November 2026. Standalone revenue for H1FY27 grew 33% year-on-year to Rs. 16,387 Mn. EBITDA decreased 10% to Rs. 887 Mn, and PAT fell 11% to Rs. 564 Mn. Copper production and sales nearly tripled year-on-year. Lead volumes remained subdued due to supply chain disruptions. The company reported positive cash flow from operations of Rs. 2,972 Mn and maintained a net cash-positive balance sheet. An investment of Rs. 200 Cr is underway for a 36,000 MTPA copper cathode facility, with Phase I expected by Dec 2026.

subject: Investor Presentation
text: Vodafone Idea Limited filed an investor presentation with the National Stock Exchange and BSE on 12 November 2026. The document outlines the company's 1-2-3 strategy targeting sustained subscriber addition, double-digit revenue growth, and thrice cash EBITDA in three years. The company announced a Rs. 45,000 Cr capex guidance for network rollout by FY29. As of September 30, 2026, the subscriber base stood at 194.4 Mn. Q2FY27 revenue from operations was Rs. 11,884 Cr, with Cash EBITDA at Rs. 2,498 Cr. The company reported a PAT loss of Rs. 5,975 Cr, including an exceptional item of Rs. 462 Cr. Promoter holding is 25.64%, with the Government of India holding 49.00%. The NSE closing price was Rs. 13.0 per share as of 30 September 2026.

subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
text: Cerebra Integrated Technologies Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board recommended the re-appointment of Mr. V Ranganathan as Managing Director and Mr. P. Vishwamurthy as Whole-time Director and CFO for three years effective 1 January 2027. These appointments are subject to shareholder approval. The independent auditor issued a disclaimer of conclusion on the financial results. The auditor cited material uncertainties regarding the company's ability to continue as a going concern due to significant operating losses, workforce reduction, and a pending Corporate Insolvency and Resolution Process application before the NCLT Bengaluru bench. The auditor could not verify the carrying value of Rs. 142.63 crore in trade receivables, Rs. 5.98 crore in loans to a subsidiary, Rs. 100.28 crore in dues from an overseas party, and Rs. 20.30 crore in other advances.

text: Landmark Cars Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Proforma revenue for Q2FY27 was Rs. 19,457 Mn, up 17.4% year-on-year. subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: All Time Plastics Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call with BSE and NSE. The call, held on November 05, 2026, featured Chairman Kailesh Shah and CFO Manish Gattani. Q2 FY27 revenue from operations grew 18% year-on-year to INR174 crores, with polymer processing volumes increasing 9% sequentially to 6,910 metric tons. Gross margin declined to 34.3% due to higher raw material costs and absorbed price increases. Domestic revenue rose 36% sequentially to 19.5% of total sales. The company plans to commence commercial bamboo production in mid-November 2026. New injection molding machines adding 1,500 tons capacity are expected in December 2026. The firm maintains a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.15 and targets 15% to 20% revenue growth for FY27.

subject: Resignation

subject: Outcome of Board Meeting

subject: Updates
text: Dish TV India Limited disclosed unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results. Operating revenue was Rs. 2,921 million. Subscription revenue stood at Rs. 1,795 million. EBITDA was negative Rs. 729 million. The loss for the quarter was Rs. 2,957 million. The active subscriber base increased to 75.56 lakh. This represents a net addition of 2.10 lakh subscribers. The company launched VZY Linear TV Streaming. VZY Smart TV sales crossed Rs. 200 crore. The company aims to strengthen its DTH business. It also plans to expand the VZY ecosystem.

subject: Outcome of Board Meeting

subject: Press Release (Revised)
text: Man Industries India Limited filed a revised press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated EBITDA reached 190 crore, up 86.6% year-on-year, with consolidated PAT growing 121.7% to 82 crore. Consolidated revenue from operations rose 49.3% to 1,216 crore. The company reported a consolidated order book of approximately 3,500 crore. Revenue of approximately 320 crore was deferred due to shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. The acquisition of National Pipe Company contributed significantly to performance. The company announced progress on the Merino Shelters joint development agreement, expected cash flows of 700 to 800 crore over five to six years, and production timelines for the Jammu greenfield plant by April 2027. Operations at the Dammam facility are targeted for March 2027. A new HSAW pipe facility in the USA with a capacity of 350,000 MTPA and planned capex of US$110 million was also disclosed.

subject: Outcome of Board Meeting

subject: General Updates
text: Baazar Style Retail Limited incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named Sunright Private Limited on November 12, 2026. subject: Capacity addition
text: EIH Limited approved the construction of a Trident five-star deluxe hotel near Shamshabad Airport, Hyderabad, during its Board Meeting on 12th November 2026. The project is situated on an 8.89-acre site owned by the Company. The estimated investment required is Rs. 777 crores. Financing will be through internal accrual and debt. The hotel is expected to be operational by September 2030. It will cater to domestic and international travelers. The initiative is part of the Company's portfolio expansion in the domestic tourism sector. The Board Meeting started at 04:00 p.m. and concluded at about 6.15 p.m. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: SAMHI Hotels Limited filed transcripts of its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call held on 04 November 2026. The company reported total income of INR342.7 crores, a 15.6% year-on-year increase. Consolidated EBITDA rose 12% to INR123.8 crores with a margin of 36.1%. Excluding INR10 crores from GST regulation changes, comparable EBITDA grew 21.3% to INR133.8 crores. Profit after tax stood at INR41.1 crores. Net debt was INR1458 crores as of September 2026. The company highlighted a secured pipeline adding 1,670 rooms and rebranding 473 rooms. Key projects include a W Hotel in Hyderabad and a Westin in Bangalore. Management expects net debt to reduce to 2.5x by the end of the fiscal year. Same-store revenue grew 12.6%, and occupancy reached 78.6%.

subject: General Updates
text: Vodafone Idea Limited submitted its quarterly report for the second quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs. 11,884 Cr and cash EBITDA of Rs. 2,498 Cr for the quarter. The subscriber base increased to 194.4 million, with blended ARPU at Rs. 178. First-half revenue grew 15% to Rs.582 crores. Collection and transportation revenue grew 26% to Rs.394 crores. Processing volumes declined 7% to 0.68 million tonnes due to suspended power generation at the PCMC Moshi waste-to-energy facility. The facility is expected to be functional by December 2026. EBITDA for the quarter was Rs.58 crores with a margin of 17.6%. An exceptional expense of Rs.20 crores was recognized for impairment and restoration costs. Gross debt stood at approximately Rs.449 crores against cash of Rs.63 crores. Net debt-to-equity ratio is 0.4x. The order book position is around Rs.18,000 crores. The company reiterated guidance of approximately 20% revenue CAGR over the next three to five years.

subject: Credit Rating- Revision
text: Brooks Laboratories Limited has received an upgrade in its credit ratings from CARE Ratings Limited. The long-term bank facilities rating is upgraded to CARE BB plus with a stable outlook, from CARE BB. The short-term bank facilities rating is upgraded to CARE A4 plus, from CARE A4. The upgrade follows the receipt of Rs. 106.33 crore from the partial divestment of its stake in Brooks Steriscience Limited. This capital infusion strengthens the company's liquidity and financial risk profile. Contingent liabilities have reduced to approximately Rs. 48.15 crore. Profit before interest, lease rentals, depreciation and taxation margin improved to 8.88 percent in FY26. The company plans to use the funds for capital expenditure. subject: Related Party Transactions
text: Niraj Ispat Industries Limited informs the National Stock Exchange that it is not required to comply with the related party transaction provisions of Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Symbiotec Pharmalab Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with the BSE and NSE. The call was held on November 06, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 was INR280 crores, a 43% year-on-year increase. H1 FY27 revenue grew 25%. Reported EBITDA grew 88% in Q2 and 29% in H1. The company recognized INR53 crores in milestone revenue from its complex injectable business. API business revenue grew 16% in Q2 and 11% in H1. The company signed a long-term agreement for dual-chamber vials with a US partner. It also signed a manufacturing agreement with a Europe-based alternate protein company. A 10-year take-or-pay contract with a US alternate protein company expects commercial batches in Q1 FY28. A 5-year contract for insulin drug substance is expected to commence sales mid-FY28. The company maintains guidance for approximately 20% revenue growth and 25% EBITDA growth for the current fiscal year.

subject: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
text: Gland Pharma Limited issued a corporate guarantee on behalf of its wholly owned step down subsidiary, Phixen SAS. The guarantee is provided to MUFG Bank Europe N.V. to secure a draw-down amount under a Uncommitted Revolving Facility Agreement. The facility is valued at Euro 50 Mn with an initial draw-down limit of Euro 18 Mn. Gland Pharma extended a corporate guarantee of EURO 20 Mn in favor of MUFG Bank. This guarantee secures the draw-down amount and interest thereon. The facility agreement is valid for 3 years. The corporate guarantee is valid until March 31, 2030. The company may extend the guarantee limit if draw-down limits for Phixen SAS increase in the future. The corporate guarantee is treated as a contingent liability for the company.

text: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY2027 earnings conference call held on 6th November 2026. The company reported record quarterly revenue of INR630.5 crores, up 14.3% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at INR82.5 crores with a margin of 13.1%, while PAT grew 25.2% to INR45.7 crores. For the first half, revenue reached INR1,179.3 crores, up 15.1%, with PAT at INR84.5 crores, up 25.4%. Management cited resilient domestic demand and strong export growth despite inflationary pressures and higher freight costs. The biscuit business grew in the low teens, while the bakery business saw high-teens growth. New product launches in quick commerce and premium segments were highlighted as key growth drivers. The company expects margin pressure in the near term due to input costs but anticipates progressive recovery as price increases annualize.

text: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited submitted a press release to the BSE and NSE on November 12, 2026. The release states that Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to dedicate the Devangonthi Marketing Terminal in Bengaluru on November 13, 2026. The terminal was developed at an investment of Rs. 330 crore. It spans 20 acres and has a storage capacity of 77,000 kilolitres. The facility handles petrol, diesel, and Aviation Turbine Fuel. It is connected to the Mangaluru refinery via a 363-kilometre pipeline. The terminal includes 10 automated truck-loading bays and biofuel blending facilities. The project aims to reduce carbon emissions by approximately 40,000 tonnes annually. It is expected to generate over 280 direct and indirect jobs.

subject: Press Release
text: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board to invest approximately Rs. 50,000 crore. This infrastructure will power a 2 GW Green Compute Factory in the Kurnool District. The company aims to accelerate execution in water and renewable segments during the second half of FY27.

company: R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems Limited
subject: Press Release
text: R M Drip And Sprinklers Systems Limited reported standalone financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Profit before tax was 290.78 lakhs, down from 704.36 lakhs in the previous quarter and 803.96 lakhs in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. The profit before tax margin declined to 9.02 percent from 25.78 percent. Revenue stood at 3,222.17 lakhs. The decline was driven by a 40 percent increase in raw material prices due to geopolitical tensions, delayed inventory cycle impacts, infrastructure investments, government-prescribed selling rates, and drought conditions reducing sales by approximately 30 percent. Management expects these factors to be temporary and plans corrective measures including renegotiating supplier terms and focusing on operational efficiency.

Australia saw good unit growth but muted service revenue. Material costs increased, impacting EBITDA by Rs. 170 million. Foreign exchange provided a positive benefit. A US tariff refund of Rs. 40 crores was received in August and September. Fifty to sixty percent of this refund was recognized in the current quarter. Net cash increased by Rs. 200 million. The release announces that LTM's proprietary AI-powered Quantum Error Mitigation capability, named AI-QEM, is now available in the IBM Quantum Functions Catalog. LTM states it is the first Global Systems Integrator worldwide to publish a function in this catalog. The AI-QEM function allows users to apply error mitigation directly within Qiskit workflows. It uses advanced AI models to correct device-specific error patterns through classical post-processing. This method supports improved result accuracy without additional quantum processing unit time or extra qubits. The capability has been validated on IBM Quantum computers across experiments involving more than 100 qubits.

The article referenced past shipments where modules were declared Indian-origin, while US Customs used cell origin for duty purposes. This matter was previously disclosed on June 28, 2026. US Customs and Border Protection confirmed Waaree did not ship modules made with Chinese cells and limited duty liability to a small set of past shipments. No new financial or operational impact resulted from the findings. Possible exposure to anti-dumping and countervailing duties is already reflected in financial statements disclosed on November 2, 2026. The order book rationalization mentioned in the article was disclosed with results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company is evaluating a challenge to the US Customs decision before the US Court of International Trade.

subject: Press Release

Cyient will offer 3-GIS network management software solutions alongside its engineering, implementation, migration, and managed services. The partnership targets telecom and utility operators in North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. Cyient will integrate 3-GIS with its CYiNGINE Engineering Intelligence Platform. This integration aims to help customers accelerate deployment and simplify long-term network management. The combined offering provides a single engagement model for platform and services. Cyient brings over three decades of experience in geospatial and digital services. It has managed more than 650 million network data elements. subject: Disruption of Operations
text: Sangam India Limited intimates that a fire occurred at its Denim Division in Village Biliya Kalan, Bhilwara, on 9th November 2026 at 01:00 A.M. No human injuries were reported. The estimated loss is approximately Rs. 5 crores. The damage is covered by insurance with a sum insured of Rs. 583 crores and additional coverage of Rs. 145 crores for loss of profit. The incident affected plant machinery, raw materials, and buildings. The impact on overall production and operations is expected to be minor. The company is assessing the exact cause and extent of damage. Claims have been initiated with the insurer.

subject: Press Release
text: Intellect Design Arena Limited announces the launch of Xponent Portfolio Navigator by its Insurtech unit, IntellectAI. This AI application is designed for commercial and specialty insurers to manage portfolio risk and performance. The tool allows carriers to view key metrics, identify book drift, and take actions such as repricing or non-renewal directly within the application. It integrates portfolio analytics, AI, and underwriting workflows. The solution is built on the Purple Fabric platform and is available as part of Intellect Xponent or as a standalone product via APIs. The company states the product is available now. A media release dated November 11, 2026, is enclosed for record.

The company reported record quarterly revenue of INR1,045 crores, up 33% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at INR127 crores and PAT at INR53 crores. For the half-year, revenue was INR1,906 crores with PAT at INR94 crores. Managing Director Anurag Soni stated the company is on track to double PAT for FY27. Capacity utilization remains high. The company is investing INR1,500 crores over two to three years to expand capacity and increase renewable power generation to 70% by Q1 next year. Debtor days increased to 77 days due to government tenders and export delays. India Ratings upgraded the long-term rating to IND A with a stable outlook.

subject: General Updates
text: Texmaco Rail and Engineering Limited filed an earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue from operations reached Rs 863 crore in Q2 FY27, up 14.6 percent from Rs 753 crore in Q1. Profit before tax was Rs 51.2 crore, compared to Rs 44.1 crore in the previous quarter. EBITDA margin stood at 10.2 percent. The consolidated order book increased by 10.2 percent to Rs 10,940 crore as of 30th September 2026. The company secured an additional freight car order worth Rs 412 crore from Indian Railways in October 2026. New orders added between 1st October 2026 and 5th November 2026 totaled Rs 349 crore from Indian Railways. The company received an upgraded CRISIL A+/Stable rating for long-term bank facilities. ESG score improved from 51 to 59.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Apollo Pipes Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 06, 2026. Consolidated sales volume grew 13% year-on-year to 24,501 tons, with revenue rising 31% to INR309.6 crores. Consolidated EBITDA recovered to INR11.5 crores, representing a 3.7% margin. The company entered the ceramic tiles segment through the acquisition of Mazzini Tiles. Management targets expanding capacity to 2,88,000 tons within two years, funded by internal cash flow. Apollo Pipes standalone EBITDA margin stood at 5.7%. The company aims to reach an EBITDA per ton of INR9,000 to INR10,000 for Apollo standalone in the second half of FY27. Kisan is targeted to reach breakeven in the next six months.

subject: Press Release
text: Jyoti Structures Limited announces the progressive release of bank guarantees and letters of credit by its lenders. This action follows the NCLT approved resolution plan under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, and the NCLAT order dated 26 May 2026. After a five-year delay, lenders are disbursing facilities from the INR 510.59 crores envisaged in the plan. These facilities are being made available in line with current business requirements. The prior non-availability of these instruments limited the company's ability to execute its order book. Their release strengthens the operational platform and supports the execution of the growing order book. The company aims to pursue new opportunities in the power transmission and infrastructure sectors. The press release was issued on November 11, 2026.

subject: Press Release
text: JSW Steel reported consolidated crude steel production of 25.73 Lakh Tonnes for October 2026, representing a 19% year-on-year growth. Indian operations contributed 24.86 Lakh Tonnes, while JSW Steel USA Ohio contributed 0.87 Lakh Tonnes. Capacity utilization for Indian operations was 92%. Previous year figures have been adjusted to exclude the Bhushan Power and Steel Limited steel business undertaking transferred to JSW-JFE Steel Limited in March 2026. The company is the flagship business of the JSW Group and aims to expand its combined crude steel capacity to 54.8 MTPA over the next four years.

subject: Press Release
text: HEG Advanced Materials Limited disclosed that its wholly owned subsidiary, TACC Limited, received an approval letter for an incentive of Rs 609.50 crore under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme. The incentive supports TACC’s Synthetic Graphite Anode Material project in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh. The facility spans over 100 acres and targets a phase one capacity of 20,000 tonnes per annum by June 2027. The project aims for a total committed capacity beyond 30,000 metric tonnes per annum by FY2028-29. The approval is subject to scheme guidelines and prescribed conditions.

company: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited
subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR1,363 crores, an EBITDA of INR279 crores, and a PAT of INR76 crores. Operational highlights included IP volumes of 81,668 and OP volumes of 731,010. Management discussed acquisitions in Kakinada, Sangli, Secunderabad, and Guntur, along with operations management agreements in Hyderabad and Thrissur. The call addressed the impact of trade margin rationalization on anti-cancer drugs, noting final details were pending disclosure on 9th November. Management also commented on the ramp-up of the Kondapur unit, margin normalization in the Andhra Pradesh cluster due to new oncology programs, and a one-time INR8 crores provision for doubtful debts related to government business.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Aegis Logistics Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 03, 2026. The company announced a definitive agreement dated October 13, 2026, to acquire an 89.8% stake in Tristar Holdings Limited for US$809 million, pending regulatory approvals and expected to close in Q4 FY27. For H1 FY27, Aegis reported revenue of INR4,570 crores, EBITDA of INR1,184 crores, and profit after tax of INR866 crores. EPS for the half-year was INR21.23. For Q2 FY27, revenue was INR2,213 crores, EBITDA INR456 crores, and PAT INR321 crores. Aegis Vopak Terminals reported Q2 revenue of INR271 crores and EBITDA of INR212 crores. Expansion projects include a 64,000 cubic meter liquid storage facility at Mumbai, an LPG bottling plant at JNPT, and a 94,148 cubic meter CRL-4 terminal at Kandla. An ammonia terminal at Pipavav was commissioned with a 15-year agreement with Hindustan Zinc and a 10% stake acquired by ITOCHU Corporation.

subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
text: Rentomojo Limited approved unaudited financial results for Q2 FY 2026-27 ending September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue was Rs. 1,421.13 million, with a net profit of Rs. 181.93 million. Basic earnings per share stood at Rs. 1.84. The Board also approved remuneration revisions for Executive Director Ketan Krishna, DIN 09032220, and other Key Managerial Persons, effective April 1, 2026. Designation changes were approved for Rohan Ajeet Kulkarni and Prabhat Verma, effective November 10, 2026. CRISIL Ratings Limited confirmed no deviation in the utilization of issue proceeds for the quarter. The Board meeting concluded at 7:31 P.M. on November 10, 2026.

subject: Updates
text: HCL Technologies Ltd. has announced a collaboration with PTC to accelerate semiconductor product lifecycle management. The partnership involves launching a pre-configured semiconductor Product Lifecycle Management solution built on the PTC Windchill platform. This solution aims to streamline product development, strengthen quality and compliance, and reduce operational complexity. It connects people, processes, and data across the semiconductor lifecycle, including IP management, new product introduction, supplier collaboration, and regulatory compliance. The solution integrates with existing business, manufacturing, and design systems for end-to-end visibility. HCLTech and PTC stated that the collaboration helps customers modernize product development and management at scale. The announcement was filed with the BSE and NSE on November 10, 2026.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 03, 2026. Chairman Raj Chandaria announced a definitive agreement dated October 13, 2026, to acquire an 89.8% stake in Tristar Holdings Limited for US$809 million. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions, with completion expected in Q4 of FY27. For the first half of FY27, Aegis Logistics reported revenue of INR4,570 crores, EBITDA of INR1,184 crores, and profit after tax of INR866 crores. Earnings per share for the half-year was INR21.23. For the second quarter, revenue was INR2,213 crores, EBITDA was INR456 crores, and profit after tax was INR321 crores. Aegis Vopak Terminals reported Q2 revenue of INR271 crores and EBITDA of INR212 crores. The company highlighted expansion projects at JNPT, Kandla, and Pipavav, including the commissioning of an ammonia terminal at Pipavav with a 10% stake acquired by ITOCHU Corporation.

subject: Investor Presentation
text: NGL Fine-Chem Limited submitted its Q2FY27 investor presentation to BSE and NSE on November 10, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 158.71 crore rupees for Q2FY27, up 31.97 percent year-on-year. Profit after tax stood at 16.25 crore rupees, a 68.74 percent increase year-on-year. EBITDA margin improved to 17.68 percent. The company commissioned Phase II of its new facility, which is now fully staffed. Operating costs from the new plant are expected to weigh on margins as utilization builds toward 30 to 40 percent over the next two to three quarters. Regulatory filings for the US include Veterinary Master Files for nine products. European registrations are being transferred to the new facility, with completion expected by the end of 2027. The presentation is available on the company website.

subject: Investor Presentation
text: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited filed an investor and analyst presentation regarding its standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation is available on the company website. The document outlines the company's history, investment highlights, strategic priorities, and performance summary. It details the Indian jewellery market size at 7,204 billion rupees and the company's presence with 33 showrooms in Kerala, 504 in South India, 38 in North India, 2 in West India, and 2 in East India. The company operates 1,203 stores in India and has a global presence. Financial metrics mentioned include revenue figures in millions of rupees for various segments. The presentation covers Q2FY27 and H1FY27 performance for India, Middle East, and consolidated operations. It also discusses the franchise model and asset-light journey.

subject: General Updates
text: Jindal Steel and Power Limited received an order from the Additional Commissioner of CGST and Central Excise, Rourkela Commissionerate, on November 10, 2026. The order relates to alleged excess Input Tax Credit claimed and utilized beyond what was reported in GSTR-2A. The company is evaluating the order and may file an appeal. The alleged excess Input Tax Credit amounts to INR 8,41,20,475 and was utilized between June 2020 and March 2022. The order includes recovery under section 74 of the CGST Act, confirmed interest under Section 50, and a penalty of INR 8,41,20,475 under Sections 74 and 122. The company states that the amounts involved are not material and are not expected to have any material impact on its financial, operational, or other activities.

text: JSW Dulux Limited filed a transcript of its group investor call held on 4th November 2026 regarding financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a volume growth of 21% and revenue growth of 21.3%. EBITDA stood at INR110.9 crores, up 4.4% from INR106.3 crores. subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Standard Engineering Technology Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 05, 2026. The company reported total revenue of INR296.6 crores for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, a 62.3% year-on-year increase. EBITDA rose 79.7% to INR51.4 crores, while profit after tax grew 37.9% to INR28.2 crores. Management highlighted strong growth in the core engineering business driven by CDMO orders and international expansion. The company is advancing its GScale Energy venture, targeting revenue generation from secondary fluid networks by December 15, 2026, and power lines by January 15, 2027. Standard Engineering holds a 19.19% stake in GScale and awaits stock exchange approval to increase its holding to 51% via a share swap. The company also acquired a stake in GL Hakko Company Limited to enhance technology capabilities. Full-year revenue guidance for FY27 stands at INR1,450 crores.

subject: Press Release
text: Hirect Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported highest-ever standalone revenue from operations of Rs. 294.3 crore in Q2FY27 and Rs. 530.7 crore in H1FY27. Consolidated revenue reached Rs. 315.7 crore in Q2FY27 and Rs. 574.1 crore in H1FY27. Standalone PAT was Rs. 14.5 crore in Q2FY27 and Rs. 29.6 crore in H1FY27. Consolidated PAT after Minority Interest stood at Rs. 6.8 crore in Q2FY27 and Rs. 16.2 crore in H1FY27. These figures include exceptional gains from the sale of the Dehradun plant. The order book stood at Rs. 795.2 crore as of September 2026. The company received CTC and PICC approvals from Indian Railways and was included in RDSO's UVAM list.

subject: Investor Presentation
text: Hirect Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation is available on the company website and will be used for an earnings conference call. The company highlighted its evolution into a technology-led systems provider for railway and industrial sectors. Key developments include the acquisition of Elventive France in 2025-26 to establish a European manufacturing footprint for EMS, robotics, and power electronics. Hirect launched commercial production of specialized copper conductors for transformer applications, securing orders from private customers. The company received approvals from Indian Railways for deploying these conductors in traction transformers. The firm operates two manufacturing plants in Nashik and maintains R&D centers in Mumbai and Hyderabad. Leadership includes Chairman and Managing Director Suramya Nevatia and Chief Financial Officer Anil Kumar Nemani.

The meeting discussed performance for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Chairman and Managing Director Vamsi Rama Mohan Burra reported fixed assets of ₹3.29 lakh crore and a market cap of ₹2.42 lakh crore. Capital expenditure guidance was raised to ₹40,000 crore, with capitalization expected between ₹25,000 crore and ₹30,000 crore. The order pipeline stands at ₹2.20 lakh crore, including ₹1.95 lakh crore under TBCB. The company commissioned 981 circuit kilometres of transmission lines and 14,600 MVA transformation capacity in Q2. Revenue collections remain robust with receivable dues at 10.54 days.

text: Dhoot Transmission Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY2026-27 earnings conference call with the NSE and BSE. The call was held on November 3, 2026. The company reported a 60% year-on-year revenue growth. EV revenue grew 108%, contributing 31% of total sales. Organic adjusted EBITDA margins remained at 15.2%. Pre-exceptional PAT was Rs. 162 crores. Net cash and bank balances stood at Rs. 900 crores. The company revised its annual growth guidance to more than 40%. CAPEX guidance for the year was increased to around Rs. 750 crores. Five new plants are planned for the next 12 months. Battery and electronics CAPEX is estimated at Rs. 150 to Rs. 200 crores.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: IFB Industries Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call to BSE and NSE. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue was INR1,512 crores, up 14.04% from INR1,327 crores. PBDIT declined 11.3% to INR90.92 crores due to higher material costs and adverse forex impacts. PBT was INR53.86 crores, and PAT was INR39.56 crores. Year-to-date revenue stood at INR3,042 crores, up 15.34%, with PAT at INR77.62 crores. The Engineering division reported growth driven by fine blanking and stamping, with a business mix of 50% two-wheelers, 40% four-wheelers, and 10% electrical and three-wheelers. A new EV manufacturing facility in Gujarat is under construction, expected to commence operations by September or October 2027. The Steel division increased annealing capacity to 2,800 tons per month, with a customer base split 60% internal and 40% external.

text: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited disclosed unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total income for the half year was 1893.09 million, up 24 percent year on year. EBITDA stood at 678.47 million, a 37 percent increase. Profit after tax reached 277.96 million, reflecting a 54 percent growth. Earnings per share were 5.38. For the second quarter, profit after tax grew 69 percent to 149.50 million. EBITDA rose 45 percent to 363.17 million. The company opened five new diagnostic centres. Suraksha Genomics continues to build its presence. The announcement was made on November 10, 2026.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Emami Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. Consolidated revenue grew by 36% to INR1,088 crores. Domestic sales rose by 49% with volume growth of 43%. EBITDA increased by 25% to INR222 crores. Profit before tax grew by 29% to INR194 crores. Profit after tax was INR144 crores, down by 3%. The Board approved an interim dividend of INR5 per share. The company completed a share buyback worth INR281 crores. International revenue declined by 2% due to disruptions in Nepal and Iraq. Excluding these markets, international business grew by 6%. Gross margins moderated by 520 basis points due to input cost inflation. Strategic investments contributed approximately 26% of domestic business.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates

For H1 FY2027, revenue grew 30% to INR4,319 crores, EBITDA nearly doubled to INR369 crores with an 8.6% margin, and PAT grew more than 4x to INR161 crores. Q2 FY2027 revenue rose 19% to INR1,900 crores, with EBITDA at INR131 crores and PAT at INR40 crores. The company operates 229 stores across 102 cities. Management expects festive season demand to be strong and plans to enter West Bengal with four to five stores by mid-November. Working capital days stood at 61 as of 30th September 2026.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Cosmo First Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 04, 2026. Consolidated sales for the September 2026 quarter reached Rs. 1,388 crore, a 51% year-on-year increase. EBITDA grew 38% to Rs. 177 crore, including a Rs. 24.8 crore write-back from US customs duty refunds and a Rs. 7 crore inventory loss. Excluding these items, EBITDA was Rs. 159 crore. The company adopted the new tax regime for FY27, expecting an effective tax rate between -6% and -7%. Net debt reduced to Rs. 1,057 crore. Management highlighted strong growth in specialty chemicals, rigid packaging, and consumer verticals Zigly and Cosmo Consumer. Capacity additions for specialty films and barrier sheets are planned for the second half of FY27. Renewable power is expected to meet two-thirds of power requirements by next year, saving Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore annually.

The company has received export orders for the coming quarter. Net cash on a consolidated basis increased to INR 36 crores as on 30th September 2026.

text: Websol Energy System Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings call held on 5th November 2026. The company reported half-year revenue of INR 734 crores and net profit of INR 80 crores for the period ended 30th September 2026. Websol became debt-free in August 2026 after repaying IREDA debt. Solar cell utilization stood at 91 percent, with module utilization at 68 percent. The order book reached INR 1,280 crores. The Board approved a 4 gigawatt integrated facility in West Bengal on 54.20 acres, planned in two phases. Phase one costs INR 1,350 crores. The company is converting its MonoPERC line to TOPCon technology. The Board also approved entering EPC, independent power production, and energy trading sectors. It approved subscribing to 40 percent of Bright Earth Cell Private Limited for energy trading. Vinay was appointed CEO of Websol Renewables. Trial runs for the new facility are targeted for the third quarter of the next financial year.

Kalyani announced a board-approved Rs. 45 crore funding plan comprising Rs. 10 crore equity, Rs. 20 crore debt, and up to Rs. 20 crore from non-core asset and inventory monetization. First half of FY27 Profit Before Tax rose 118% year-on-year to Rs. 9.39 crore, while Profit After Tax increased 86% to Rs. 6.64 crore. Second quarter EBITDA margin stood at 14.2%, marking the fourth consecutive quarter above this threshold. Truck segment sales surged 75% year-on-year to Rs. 23.3 crore, representing 43% of total sales. Revenue declined 18% sequentially to Rs. 54.4 crore due to planned downtime from reconditioning a 2,500-ton press and relocating the driveline machining plant. Receivables increased due to delayed remittances during a banking changeover. The company is normalizing collections and expanding capacity for new engine and wheel hub orders.

subject: Investor Presentation
text: Mukka Proteins Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its Q2 and FY27 unaudited financial results for the period ended 30th September 2026. The company reported an export revenue share of 81.3% for Q2 FY27. It commenced commercial production at its new Al Juba facility in Oman during the quarter. The firm secured US FDA facility registration for its Oman and Mangaluru facilities. Mukka Proteins holds approximately 25 to 30% market share in fish meal and fish oil revenue. The company targets revenue growth from 1,449 crore rupees in FY26 to over 3,000 crore rupees by FY30. It operates 18 owned in-house production facilities in India and Oman. The presentation highlights a strategic shift toward an integrated animal protein and sustainability platform.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Vardhman Textiles Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with the BSE and NSE on 10th November 2026. The call was held on 6th November 2026. Management reported improved yarn business performance driven by higher demand, rising yarn prices, and trading gains from low-cost cotton purchases. Current cotton landed costs are approximately INR65,000 per candy. The fabric business faced challenges due to lower export volumes, tariff uncertainty, and higher input costs. The company expects improved order pipelines following US election results. An open-end yarn project with a capacity of 50 tons per day is expected to be operational in six to seven months. No major capital expenditure plans for the spinning business have been announced for the next two years.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates

The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 121.3 crores for Q2 FY27, up from INR 98.4 crores in Q2 FY26. Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 7.6 crores. For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue stood at INR 230.20 crores, with profit after tax at INR 18.7 crores. Management highlighted capacity expansion in Palghar and an Egypt facility with increased capacity to 60,000 MTPA. Partial capacity in Egypt is expected by 31st December, 2026. Sales from Platinum Oleo chemicals reached INR 11.4 crores in Q2 FY27. The company noted rising ocean freight costs impacting margins but expects utilization improvements in the second half of FY27.

subject: Monitoring Agency Report
text: Trejhara Solutions Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue of Equity Shares and Convertible Warrants totaling Rs 162.17 crore. The issue period was from January 27, 2026, to February 10, 2026. The company has utilized Rs 50.44 crore, primarily for strategic acquisitions. Rs 111.73 crore remains unutilized as it is yet to be received from warrant holders. The report notes that the warrant conversion price of Rs 162.00 per share is higher than the closing market price of Rs 124.05 per share on October 15, 2026, posing a risk of non-exercise of conversion rights. The report was reviewed by the Audit Committee and Board of Directors on November 6, 2026.

Payment will be made within 30 days from the declaration date. The record date for determining eligible shareholders is 6th November 2026. subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
text: Sula Vineyards Limited received an Order-in-Original dated 30th October 2026 from the Assistant Commissioner CGST Nashik on 8th November 2026. The order confirms a differential GST liability of Rs. 1,54,34,022 for FY 2022-23. This relates to restaurant services taxed at 5% instead of the alleged 18% rate. A penalty of Rs. 15,43,402 is also imposed. Interest is applicable but not quantified. The total financial implication excluding interest is Rs. 1,69,77,424. The company states the impact is not material to its financials. Sula Vineyards disagrees with the findings. The company is pursuing appellate remedies against the order. It expects a favorable outcome at the higher forum.

The company reported consolidated revenue growth of 47.5% for Q2 and 49.6% for H1. Net revenue growth excluding alloy price pass-through was 29.5% for Q2 and 27.6% for H1. Q2 EBITDA was INR185 crores with a margin of 11.8%. Q2 PAT was INR102 crores. H1 EBITDA was INR348 crores with a margin of 11.9%. H1 PAT was INR187 crores. Export revenue rose 133.3% year-on-year in Q2 to INR70 crores. High-pressure diecast alloy wheel supplies commenced on August 03, 2026. An 11.55 megawatt solar plant in Bikaner became operational in October 2026. The company budgeted INR700 crores for capital expenditure in the current year.

The company reported revenue from operations of INR85.66 crores for Q2 FY27, up 28% year-on-year, with EBITDA at INR13.87 crores and profit after tax at INR6.82 crores. For H1 FY27, revenue reached INR174.62 crores, a 50% increase, while EBITDA rose 63% to INR24.56 crores and profit after tax grew 22% to INR12.42 crores. The nuts division recorded revenue of INR63.16 crores, and the ice cream division reported INR22.50 crores. Management announced expanded production capacity for nuts and a deep freezer network of 18,752 units for ice cream. Vivek Kumar Jain joined as Chief Business Officer effective October 23, 2026.

The company reported a 20% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 3,219 crore and an 18% increase in operating EBITDA to INR 820 crore for the second quarter. Profit after tax rose 10% to INR 448 crore. Average network occupancy remained steady at 77% despite a 14% increase in bed capacity. The Board approved an investment of INR 415 crore for adding 209 brownfield beds at Max Noida, Max Vaishali, and BLK-Max, along with a car park tower at BLK. Shareholding in Kalinga Hospital Limited increased to 66%. The transcript is available on the company website.

The defect liability period is 10 years. The awarding entity is a domestic entity. This announcement follows the initial bid submission reported on November 05, 2026.

subject: Press Release
text: Tata Motors disclosed that its subsidiary TML CV Holdings B.V. reached a 96.25% shareholding in Iveco Group N.V. following the reopening of terms for a voluntary totalitarian tender offer. During the reopening, which concluded on November 9, 2026, 18,203,217 common shares were tendered. The offer price is EUR 14.40 per share. Payment for these shares is scheduled for November 13, 2026. With shareholding exceeding 95%, the offeror announced it will initiate a Dutch legal squeeze-out for the remaining 3.68% of outstanding shares. Trading in Iveco Group N.V. shares will be suspended by Borsa Italiana. The squeeze-out will proceed without a prior demerger and share sale. Details on the squeeze-out timeline will be released separately.

subject: Credit Rating

If the company does not avail the proposed facilities within 180 days from the letter date, a fresh revalidation letter from CRISIL Ratings will be necessary.

H1 brand revenue reached Rs. 325.7 crores, growing 48% year-on-year. Air conditioner sales surged 239% in Q2, while LED TV sales rose 52%. subject: Action(s) taken or orders passed
text: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited received an Adjudication Order dated 07.11.2026 from the Assistant Commissioner of the Telangana Commercial Tax Department on 09.11.2026. The order drops the entire GST demand of Rs. 207.26 Crore raised for the financial year 2022-23, along with consequential interest and penalty. This follows a previous favorable order for FY 2021-22, which dropped a demand of Rs. 183.77 Crore. The company initially faced tentative GST demands totaling Rs. 586.43 Crore across three financial years. The matter for FY 2023-24, involving a demand of Rs. 194.62 Crore, remains under adjudication. The company states there are no financial implications or penalties imposed. No action is warranted as the authority has dropped the raised demand.

text: KSH International Limited submitted the transcript of its earnings conference call for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026, held on November 05, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs. 1,320 crores, an 85% increase year-over-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 90 crores, with EBITDA per ton at approximately Rs. 1,01,000. Profit after tax reached a quarterly record of Rs. 48 crores. Export revenue grew 108% year-over-year, representing 32% of total revenue. Installed capacity reached 57,845 metric tons, with 96% of Phase-2 expansion complete. The board approved a Phase-3 expansion to add capacity, targeting a total installed capacity of approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029. The investment is estimated at up to Rs. 1,850 million. The company generated Rs. 43 crores in positive operating cash flow during H1 FY 2027.

text: Carysil Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on November 05, 2026. The company reported a record second quarter revenue of INR275.7 crores, representing a 14.6% year-on-year growth. Core sink business volumes grew, with quartz sinks up 10% and stainless steel sinks up 8%. Capacity expansion for quartz and steel sinks is targeted for the end of FY2027. International partners include IKEA, Lowe's, and Home Depot. Domestic revenue grew by 30% in the first half. The company appointed Bobby Deol as brand ambassador for FY2027 and FY2028. Management maintains FY2027 guidance of 15% revenue growth and an EBITDA margin of 18% to 20%. Q2 EBITDA margin was 19.4%. Profit after tax increased by 5.8% to reflect higher raw material costs and sea freight.

Standalone EBITDA grew 60% to INR 51.16 crores, while PAT surged 213% to INR 10.22 crores. Consolidated EBITDA rose 77% to INR 56 crores, and PAT increased to INR 11.74 crores. Management highlighted capacity expansions in EMS, AC, and compressors, with compressor capacity set to double to 60 lakh units by the end of the financial year. The company aims for a consistent CAGR of over 30% in the coming years.

subject: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
text: TCC Concept Limited has extended a corporate guarantee towards an Overdraft facility availed by its material subsidiary, Pepperfry Limited. The guarantee is issued in favor of ICICI Bank Limited to secure credit facilities aggregating to 30 crore rupees sanctioned to Pepperfry Limited. This amount comprises an Overdraft facility of 30.00 crore rupees, which includes a Working Capital Demand Loan sub-limit and a Bank Guarantee facility of 17.50 crore rupees. The facilities are intended to meet Pepperfry Limited's working capital requirements and permitted financial and performance guarantee requirements. The promoter group does not have any interest in this transaction, and the guarantee has been provided on an arm's length basis. The corporate guarantee will be treated as a contingent liability for TCC Concept Limited.

text: Thomas Cook India Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 3, 2026. Consolidated total income was INR 20,030 million, a 5% decline year-on-year. The Financial Services segment reported a 21% revenue increase, with gross turnover at INR 39 billion and EBIT at INR 452 million. The Travel segment revenue declined 7% to INR 15,683 million, with EBIT margins at 2.9%. Domestic travel grew 8%, while long-haul outbound faced headwinds from geopolitical disruptions and visa issues. The company expanded its branch network to 310 locations. Digital adoption in financial services reached 22.4%. The transcript is available on the company website.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Bata India Limited filed a transcript of its Post Earnings Call held on November 4, 2026, with the BSE, NSE, and CSE. The call covered the 2QFY27 earnings. Sanjay Rao, Managing Director and CEO, reported a turnover of 8.6 million for the quarter, showing 7.5% growth. Adjusted profit before tax grew by over 31% year-on-year. The company noted double-digit growth in franchisee and I&D channels. E-commerce grew healthily despite B2B order deferments. I&D grew in mid-teens. Ad spends increased by over 4% year-on-year. Stock turn is higher than 2.6. Freshness in stores is over 90%. Aged inventory is close to 5%. The company aims to focus on franchising, premiumization, and casualization. New global product lines are in the pipeline. The transcript is available on the company website.

subject: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
text: Auri Grow India Limited reports the outcome of the second Committee of Creditors meeting held on 28th October 2026. The Committee approved the reimbursement of expenses for registered valuers, forensic auditors, accountants, and the publication of Form G. The company is undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process admitted by the National Company Law Tribunal on 18th September 2026. An invitation for expression of interest is issued. The last date for receipt of expressions of interest is 13th November 2026. The provisional list of prospective resolution applicants will be issued on 23rd November 2026. The last date for submission of objections is 28th November 2026. The final list of applicants will be issued on 08th December 2026. The information memorandum and request for resolution plans will be issued on 13th December 2026. The last date for submission of resolution plans is 08th January 2027. Revenue for FY 2024-25 was Rs. 17948.89 Lacs and for FY 2025-2026 was Rs. 1379.50 Lacs.

subject: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process

The company was admitted into the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process by the National Company Law Tribunal Indore Bench on 18th September 2026. The Committee approved the reimbursement of expenses for the public announcement of the insolvency initiation. Other costs directly relating to the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process were also approved for inclusion in the Insolvency Resolution Process costs. The remuneration of the Interim Resolution Professional was approved. A Resolution Professional was appointed, and their fees were finalized. The Committee approved the reduction in the notice period required to call for future Committee of Creditors meetings. Rajesh Jasti, the Resolution Professional, signed the disclosure.

The call, held on November 04, 2026, featured Managing Director Bhushan Akshikar and Chief Financial Officer Ronojit Biswas. Revenues for the quarter ended September increased 21% year-on-year to INR1,180 crores, marking the highest quarterly sales recorded. EBITDA stood at INR400 crores, growing 20%, with margins maintained at 34%. The innovation portfolio contributed 7% of overall revenues, up from 3% in the same quarter last year. Input cost pressures due to rupee appreciation and oil-linked inflation were acknowledged, with plans to use competitive price increases to manage costs.

subject: General Updates
text: Neogen Chemicals Limited received a Revocation of Direction order from the Gujarat Pollution Control Board on November 7, 2026. This order revokes previous directives issued after the March 5, 2025 fire incident at the Dahej SEZ Multi-Purpose Plant 3 facility. The Board also granted a provisional consent order, designated CC&A amendment AWH-163560, valid until March 19, 2030. The earlier direction had imposed an Environment Damage Compensation cost of Rs. 34.60 lakhs and required a Bank Guarantee of Rs. 7.5 Lakhs. Production at the affected plant was suspended, but the company has installed a new replacement MPP-5 plant which is currently in trial production. The revocation is subject to compliance with the submitted undertaking dated September 1, 2026, and the conditions of the new consent order.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Epigral Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call to the National Stock Exchange. The call, held on 02 November 2026, featured Chairman and Managing Director Maulik Patel, Executive Director Kaushal Soparkar, and Chief Financial Officer Rakesh Agrawal. For Q2 FY27, revenue grew 28% year-on-year to INR752 crores, driven by volume growth and improved realizations. EBITDA increased 3% to INR136 crores, with margins impacted by high raw material costs. Profit after tax rose 26% to INR64 crores. Half-year revenue grew 21% to INR1,461 crores, with EBITDA at INR315 crores and PAT at INR164 crores. The company reported an ROCE of 15%, or 18% excluding capital work in progress. Net debt stood at INR514 crores. Management highlighted capacity expansions for CPVC and Epichlorohydrin nearing commissioning, alongside ongoing projects for epoxy resin and a multipurpose plant.
