subject: Credit Rating
text: Vikran Engineering Limited intimates that India Ratings and Research Private Limited assigned a credit rating of IND BBB+ with a Negative outlook to proposed Non-Convertible Debentures of INR 1,500 million. The agency reaffirmed existing ratings for Non-Convertible Debentures of INR 1,000 million and Bank Loan Facilities of INR 4,700 million, revising their outlook from Stable to Negative. The revision reflects substantial equity infusion requirements and elevated working capital intensity. Financial closure for NOPL Solar Projects Private Limited was achieved in October 2026, with anticipated debt drawdown expected to support project funding and improve liquidity.

subject: Updates

This change is subject to shareholder approval, approval from the Regional Director of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, and other statutory requirements. Operating revenues for the quarter were Rs 413.2 crores, up 10% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs 14.1 crores, with margins declining to 3.4% due to rising raw material costs and minimum wage increases. Net profit after tax excluding extraordinary items was Rs 3.8 crores. The company reported a net debt of Rs 6.4 crores and capex spend of Rs 77.5 crores in the first half of FY27. The Bhiwadi plant commenced commercial production in mid-September 2026. Management revised full-year FY2027 revenue guidance to Rs 1400 crores, plus or minus 3%. PAT for the half-year was INR20.4 crores. The company received a tariff refund of INR5.5 crores. Shareholders approved updating IPO proceeds utilization. subject: Investor Presentation
text: Power and Instrumentation Gujarat Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for H1FY27 was 111.57 crore rupees, up 12.96 percent year on year. EBITDA stood at 14.53 crore rupees, a 36.58 percent increase. Profit after tax was 9.26 crore rupees, up 26.36 percent. Earnings per share were 4.17 rupees. The company reported an order book of 320 crore rupees plus as of September 30, 2026. An active bid pipeline of 500 crore rupees plus is under evaluation. The company raised its stake in subsidiary Peaton Electrical to 60 percent in March 2026. Management projects 30 percent revenue growth for FY27.

subject: Investor Presentation
text: Mamata Machinery Limited filed an earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2FY27 was 4,105 IN ₹ LAKHS, a 23% year-over-year decline. Half-year revenue was 7,732 IN ₹ LAKHS, a 16% year-over-year decline. The company reported an EBITDA loss of 555 IN ₹ LAKHS for H1FY27, compared to an EBITDA of 987 IN ₹ LAKHS in H1FY26. Profit after tax for H1FY27 was a loss of 452 IN ₹ LAKHS, versus a profit of 718 IN ₹ LAKHS in H1FY26. Management cited elevated crude oil and polymer prices, customer working capital strain, and a five-day plant shutdown due to flooding as factors affecting execution. The company stated it expects to achieve FY27 revenue on par with FY26 through higher execution in the second half.

subject: Initiation of Forensic Audit
text: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited has engaged PKF Consulting Services LLP to conduct a forensic audit regarding a cyber fraud incident. The incident involved unauthorized transactions from a bank account on November 1, 2026, totaling approximately Rs. 7.80 crore transferred to multiple beneficiary accounts. The company confirms that business operations are continuing as usual and the incident has not materially impacted operations. This intimation is filed under SEBI Listing Regulations.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Wonderla Holidays Limited reported Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings on November 03, 2026. Q2 income grew 42% year-on-year to INR126 crores, with EBITDA rising 90% to INR30 crores and margin expanding to 24%. The company moved from a loss to a profit of INR5 lakh in the quarter. H1 income increased 41% to INR378 crores, and EBITDA grew 47% to INR150 crores. Chennai Park contributed INR28 crores in Q2 revenue with 1.90 lakh visitors. Existing parks Bengaluru, Kochi, Hyderabad, and Bhubaneswar saw revenue growth of 8% in Q2. Resort business revenue grew 57% year-on-year. Average ticket price declined 3% to INR983, while non-ticket revenue per guest rose 11%. Management stated there is no update on new park announcements yet.

Profit before tax was Rs. 63 million, and net profit after tax was Rs. 47 million. Diluted earnings per share were Rs. 1.36. The company secured a Rs. 3,000 million order from Stellantis N.V. for control cables. It also received a Rs. 300 million order for hood rods and a Rs. 120 million order for lighting design. Leadership changes include Mr. Rahul Desai as CEO and Mrs. Shivani Kejriwal as Additional Whole Time Director. The board approved exiting the joint venture with Aircom Remsons Automotive Private Limited. The company targets Rs. 9,000 to Rs. 10,000 million revenue by FY30.

subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
text: Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI LODR ) including circulars issued thereunder and other applicable provisions, if any, as amended from time to time, and in continuation to our intimation dated October 27, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. November 03, 2026 commenced at 16:00 Hrs (IST) and concluded at 18:15 Hrs (IST) has, inter-alia, considered and approved the following along with other matters:a) On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, together with Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors, that were placed before the Board of Directors and was taken on record.b) On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, Standalone and Consolidated Statement of Assets and Liabilities as on September 30, 2026.c) On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, Standalone and Consolidated Statement of Cash Flow for the half year ended September 30, 2026.d) Approved proposed capacity expansion by addition of new channels at various locations.e) Brand Launch: On 3 November,2026, the SKF Vertevo brand is officially launched across the organization and to our customers and stakeholders worldwide. The brand is the face of our company, it shows our personality   what we stand for, what we are passionate about and what our customers can expect from us.The SKF Vertevo brand is inspired by the world of racing, where the company has contributed to automotive innovation for decades. The identity is designed to keep a connection to the long SKF heritage and expertise, while signalling its ambition to help accelerate the future of mobility.Please note that only the brand is being launched, while the company name continues to remain the same. Any further developments will be communicated to stakeholders as and when applicable.
